pages.title: Amaravati Quantum Valley — India's first by January 2026

facts.text: What: Amaravati Quantum Valley (AQV) — ⚠ India's first Quantum Computing Valley, tech park and research hub; launch by January 2026
facts.head: News

facts.text: Announced by: Katamneni Bhaskar, Secretary, ITE&C, AP
facts.head: News

facts.text: IBM: plans logical qubit quantum computers under its Quantum Starling roadmap — fault-tolerant system by 2029 (⚠ not classical supercomputers)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Skilling partner: Ratan Tata Innovation Hub
facts.head: News

facts.text: Aligned with: National Quantum Mission (NQM); QNu project (quantum secure communication network)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Uses: pharma, EV batteries, agritech/medtech, logistics, image classification, cybersecurity
facts.head: News

pages.title: AP High Court — trans woman is a woman under Section 498A IPC

facts.text: Judge: Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa, Andhra Pradesh High Court
facts.head: News

facts.text: Ruling: trans women are legally women and can invoke IPC Section 498A (cruelty by husband/in-laws); womanhood cannot be defined by reproductive capacity
facts.head: News

facts.text: Case: petition by Viswanathan Krishnamurthy and parents against a case by Shabana, a trans woman from Ongole
facts.head: News

facts.text: Outcome: right to file upheld, but charges quashed for lack of evidence (not on gender grounds)
facts.head: News

facts.text: NALSA v. Union of India (2014) — right to self-identify gender
facts.head: Basis

facts.text: Articles 14, 15, 21
facts.head: Basis

facts.text: ⚠ Article 15 bars discrimination on grounds of sex too
facts.head: Basis

pages.title: NTR district — first in AP with 100% CCTV coverage

facts.text: ⚠ First district in AP to achieve 100% CCTV coverage — at least 4 cameras per village in all 305 inhabited villages
facts.head: News

facts.text: Led by: Commissioner of Police S.V. Rajashekhar Babu (IG rank; took charge 14 July 2023)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Cameras: 4,000+ since August 2023; plus 2,000 matrix and 300 facial recognition cameras
facts.head: News

facts.text: Integration: zonal offices and Central Command Control Centre, Vijayawada
facts.head: News

facts.text: Crimes solved with CCTV: over 80%
facts.head: News

facts.text: Target: 10,000 cameras in the Commissionerate within a year; only 500 of 1,371 places of worship covered
facts.head: News

pages.title: Jahnavi Dangeti of Palakollu — astronaut candidate for Titan Space mission

facts.text: Person: Jahnavi Dangeti, 23, of Palakollu, West Godavari district
facts.head: News

facts.text: Selected as: Astronaut Candidate (ASCAN) by US-based Titan Space Industries (TSI)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mission: Titan Space Orbital Flight in 2029 — five hours in low Earth orbit
facts.head: News

facts.text: Training: three years from 2026
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mission chief astronaut: retired NASA astronaut Col. William McArthur Jr.
facts.head: News

facts.text: Earlier (2022): completed Analog Astronaut Programme at AATC, Krakow (Poland) — ⚠ youngest Indian to do so
facts.head: News

pages.title: Balaga Ganesh — first AP para-swimmer to cross English Channel and Palk Strait

facts.text: Person: Balaga Ganesh, para-swimmer from Eluru
facts.head: News

facts.text: Swim: Palk Strait; Date: 18 April 2024; Detail: 28 km, Sri Lanka → Tamil Nadu, solo, 10 h 30 min — first para-swimmer from Telugu States
facts.head: News

facts.text: Swim: English Channel; Date: 16 June 2024; Detail: 34 km, England → France, six-member relay "Pride of India – A Team", 13 h 37 min
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Channel swim was a relay, not solo; Palk Strait was solo
facts.head: News

facts.text: English Channel: between England and France; links North Sea and Atlantic; Channel Tunnel beneath
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Palk Strait: between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka; links Bay of Bengal and Gulf of Mannar; Adam's Bridge (Rama Setu); shallow, non-navigable for large ships
facts.head: Background

facts.text: First Indian Paralympic swimming gold: Murlikant Petkar, 1972 (50 m freestyle)
facts.head: Background
